selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the object as a sock and distinguish it from other knitted garments like gloves or sleeves.
To verify the structural integrity of the knitted fabric, ensuring no 'melting' of stitches or impossible topology where the yarn connects.
To analyze the micro-texture of the yarn for AI artifacts like repetitive noise patterns or unnatural smoothing in the fibers.
To ensure the socks cast realistic shadows and sit correctly on the wooden floor plane without floating or bleeding into the background.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the heel and the sole. In AI images, this 'turn' often fails to make geometric sense. Also, check if the variegated color changes follow the logic of the knitting rows or if they bleed randomly across stitches.
